description: Check whether each inline citation in an answer is supported by the source it points to, using CrossSource's method and failure taxonomy (supported, right_doc_wrong_passage, wrong_document, unsupported_claim). Cites to ids not in `sources` and citations where another passage clearly covers the claim are decided deterministically. Everything else returns needs_judgment with the CrossSource judge prompt to apply. Set use_client_model to have your client model judge those, where the client supports MCP sampling.

answer.description: The answer text with inline citations like [doc_id:chunk_id] or [source_id].

include_judge_prompts.description: Return the judge prompt with each needs_judgment item. Default true.

sources.description: Every passage the answering system had available (30 at most).

doc_id.description: Document id; defaults to the part of `id` before ":n".

id.description: The id used inside the brackets.

text.description: The passage text (12,000 characters at most).

use_client_model.description: Ask the client model (MCP sampling) to judge needs_judgment items. Default false.

name: check_citations
title: Check citations (CrossSource)
